mapper.update: UPDATE host_organizations SET legal_name = #{legalName}, display_name = #{displayName}, organization_type = #{organizationType}, verification_status = #{verificationStatus}, operational_status = #{operationalStatus}, default_currency = #{defaultCurrency}, timezone = #{timezone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, settings = #{settings}::jsonb, data_version = data_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND data_version = #{dataVersion}

UPDATE host_organizations SET verification_status = #{verificationStatus}, verification_submitted_at = #{verificationSubmittedAt}, verification_reason = #{verificationReason}, verification_decided_at = #{verificationDecidedAt}, verification_decided_by = #{verificationDecidedBy}, data_version = data_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND data_version = #{dataVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS organizationId, o.display_name AS displayName, o.legal_name AS legalName, o.organization_type AS organizationType, o.verification_submitted_at AS submittedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_verification_documents d WHERE d.organization_id = o.id) AS documentCount, u.full_name AS ownerName, u.email AS ownerEmail FROM host_organizations o LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.owner_user_id WHERE o.verification_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY o.verification_submitted_at ASC NULLS LAST, o.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM host_organizations WHERE verification_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT id FROM host_organizations ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM host_organizations o LEFT JOIN organization_members m ON m.organization_id = o.id WHERE o.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR (m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.member_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.valid_from IS NULL OR m.valid_from <= NOW()) AND (m.valid_until IS NULL OR m.valid_until > NOW())) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT m.*, u.full_name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email FROM organization_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT m.*, u.full_name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email FROM organization_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY m.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_members ( id, organization_id, user_id, role_code, member_status, permissions, valid_from, valid_until, invited_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{memberStatus}, #{permissions}::jsonb, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{invitedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role_code = EXCLUDED.role_code, member_status = EXCLUDED.member_status, permissions = EXCLUDED.permissions, valid_from = EXCLUDED.valid_from, valid_until = EXCLUDED.valid_until, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_member_scopes SET resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId},role_code=#{roleCode},access_effect=#{accessEffect},permissions=#{permissions}::jsonb,valid_from=#{validFrom},valid_until=#{validUntil} WHERE id=#{id} AND membership_id=#{membershipId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization_member_scopes WHERE id=#{id} AND membership_id=#{membershipId}
